response: Yes, TDP-43 type confers a distinct pattern of atrophy in frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). Research has shown that the different subtypes of TDP-43 pathology are associated with distinct patterns of brain atrophy in FTLD. For example, type A TDP-43 is often associated with atrophy in the temporal lobes, while type B is associated with atrophy in the frontal lobes, and type C is associated with atrophy in the hippocampus and parietal lobes. These distinct patterns of atrophy can help clinicians and researchers diagnose and differentiate between different subtypes of FTLD.
